- h20: negative adjustment; confidence=high; magnitude=medium; reason=Spot is below h20 anchor (+0.70%); all matched examples indicate significant downward corrections for h20 when spot is above the forecast.
- h30: negative adjustment; confidence=high; magnitude=medium; reason=Spot is below h30 anchor (+0.76%); matched examples show consistent downward adjustments for h30 when spot exceeds the forecast.
